messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":3,"verses":[{"chapter":3,"verse":26,"text":"But I wish to serve the needy at thy table\", and he consented to work, and he ate his share."},{"chapter":3,"verse":27,"text":"So I gave him his wages nevertheless, and I went home rejoicing."},{"chapter":3,"verse":28,"text":"And when he did not wish to take it, I forced him to do so, saying: \"I know that thou art a laboring man who looks for and waits for his wages, and thou must take it.\""},{"chapter":3,"verse":29,"text":"Never did I defer paying the wages of the hireling or any other, nor keep back in my house for a single evening his hire that was due to him."},{"chapter":3,"verse":30,"text":"Those that milked the cows and the ewes signaled to the passersby that they should take their share."}],"book_code":"TJOB"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 26,27,28,29,30 in this chapter.
